title: Top 100 English A0–A1 Master Guide
dek: The ultimate Top 100 A0-A1 English vocabulary blueprint: essential nouns, action verbs, descriptive adjectives, and survival phrase patterns for beginners.

blocks.text:
🌍 Looking for the 14-Language Master Guide? Explore the unified 100-chain A0–A1 Semantic Knowledge Tree across all 14 COSY target languages with milestone goals and COSYdata live linkage!

💬 4. Top 100 (17) Essential English Expressions & Phrases (A0–A1)

17 Items
Greetings & Courtesy
Hello, good morning! ↔ Goodbye, see you tomorrow!
"Hello, good morning! How are you today?"
Greetings & Courtesy
Please and thank you. ↔ You are welcome!
"A coffee, please. Thank you! — You are welcome!"
Greetings & Courtesy
Excuse me, sorry! ↔ No problem at all!
"Excuse me, where is the hotel? — No problem at all!"
Identity & Introductions
My name is Anna. ↔ Nice to meet you!
"My name is Anna. What is your name?"
Identity & Introductions
I am from London. ↔ Where are you from?
"I am from London. Where are you from?"
Identity & Introductions
I am a student. ↔ I work as a teacher.
"I am a student at school, and my father is a teacher."
Needs & Requests
Can I have water, please? ↔ Here you are!
"Can I have a glass of water, please?"
Needs & Requests
How much is this? ↔ It costs ten dollars.
"How much is this book? — It costs ten dollars."
Needs & Requests
Where is the bathroom? ↔ It is straight ahead.
"Where is the bathroom? — It is on the left."
Understanding & Communication
I understand. ↔ I don't understand.
"I don't understand. Can you repeat, please?"
Understanding & Communication
Do you speak English? ↔ Yes, a little bit.
"Do you speak English? — Yes, a little bit."
Understanding & Communication
Speak slowly, please. ↔ I speak clearly.
"Speak slowly, please. I am learning English."

"Excuse me, I need help finding the train station."

"What time is it now? — It is three o'clock."
